meta.description: Task 3 (Dev). Pulls TMDb / NewsAPI / YouTube / Google-Trends daily at 06:00 Asia/Kolkata, merges + theme-tags against Nisha's locked vocab, writes trends rows (Priya schema-lock §1a), and auto-expires stale rows. NO keys in this file — all via n8n credentials / $env placeholders.

nodes.name: Schedule 06:00 IST
nodes.notes: Fires 06:00 Asia/Kolkata daily. Workflow timezone set in settings so cron is IST, not UTC.

nodes.name: TMDb upcoming (IN)
nodes.notes: Credential 'TrendSpark TMDb API Key' = httpQueryAuth, query param name 'api_key'. Key value lives ONLY in the n8n cred store (TMDB_API_KEY). Retry x3 backoff; on fail continues so one dead source never sinks the run [03-PIPELINE-CHAIN A].

nodes.name: NewsAPI top-headlines (IN)
nodes.notes: Credential 'TrendSpark NewsAPI Key' = httpHeaderAuth, header 'X-Api-Key'. Value = NEWSAPI_KEY, cred store only. Free plan 100 req/day — one 6AM pull is safe. Category can be looped (entertainment/sports/business) in a SplitInBatches if needed.

nodes.name: YouTube mostPopular (IN)
nodes.notes: Credential 'TrendSpark YouTube Data API Key' = httpQueryAuth, query param 'key'. Value = YOUTUBE_API_KEY, cred store only. mostPopular costs ~1-5 units of the 10k/day free quota.

nodes.name: Google Trends (pytrends/SerpAPI — STUB)
nodes.notes: STUBBED: pytrends needs Python (not available in a JS Code node) and SerpAPI needs a key + account. Emits [] so the run proceeds on TMDb/NewsAPI/YouTube. Wire one of the two documented paths to activate.

nodes.name: Merge all sources
nodes.notes: Combines the 4 source streams into one item list before normalization. Missing (skipped) sources simply contribute nothing.

nodes.name: Normalize raw → {text,source,category}
nodes.notes: Shapes TMDb results / NewsAPI articles / YouTube items into a uniform raw-trend before tagging. Items with no title are dropped (never write empty text [A]).

nodes.name: Theme Tagger + row builder
nodes.notes: INLINE mirror of theme-tagger.js (canonical). Builds EXACT trends columns (Priya §1a): ULID id, source/themes as JSON strings, expires_at = detected + peak_window_days. Drops rows with no text or no themes (fail-closed, no garbage).

nodes.name: MySQL INSERT trends
nodes.notes: Writes EXACTLY the §1a columns into the Flyway-owned `trends` table (V51). Credential 'TrendSpark MySQL (influora)' holds host/user/pass — never in this file. campaign_type is validated to the closed set upstream in the tagger.

nodes.name: Schedule 06:30 IST (expiry)
nodes.notes: Separate daily trigger at 06:30 IST — runs after the pull so no just-written row is racing expiry. Auto-delete keeps stale trends from ever being suggested (spec §4).

parameters.query: DELETE FROM trends WHERE expires_at < NOW();

nodes.name: MySQL DELETE expired
nodes.notes: Auto-expire: deletes rows past expires_at (indexed idx_trends_expires). Nothing stale reaches the nudge engine.
